description: Source file implementing functions for managing a dynamic vector of parameters to get in a grouped GET operation, including initialization, destruction, adding parameters, and retrieving parameter values either individually or in groups. It facilitates efficient batch retrieval of parameters, especially for grouped parameters, via vendor-specific callbacks.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_Init(group_get_vector_t * ggv)
methods.description: Initializes a group get vector structure by setting its vector pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_Destroy(group_get_vector_t * ggv)
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with a group get vector, including individual parameter paths, values, error messages, and the vector array itself.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_Add(group_get_vector_t * ggv,char * path,int group_id)
methods.description: Adds a new parameter path and associated group_id to the group get vector, reallocating memory as needed.

methods.name: int GROUP_GET_VECTOR_FindParam(group_get_vector_t * ggv,char * path)
methods.description: Searches for a parameter path in the vector, returning its index or INVALID if not found.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_AddParams(group_get_vector_t * ggv,str_vector_t * params,int_vector_t * group_ids)
methods.description: Adds multiple parameter paths and their group_ids, transferring ownership of the strings into the vector.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_ConvertToKeyValueVector(group_get_vector_t * ggv,kv_vector_t * kvv)
methods.description: Converts the internal vector into a key-value vector, transferring ownership of parameter values, and clears the original vector.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_GetValues(group_get_vector_t * ggv)
methods.description: Retrieves the values of all parameters, handling grouped parameters via callback functions and non-grouped directly, supporting chunked group calls.

methods.name: void GetParameterGroup(int group_id,group_get_vector_t * ggv,int_vector_t * iv,int start_index,int chunk_size)

ctags.name: GetParameterGroup
ctags.pattern: /^void GetParameterGroup(int group_id, group_get_vector_t *ggv, int_vector_t *iv, int start_index,/
